text:
olivia: Quick heads-up — saw a perf regression on AWQ weight-only path after the kernel-chooser change. P50 for short sequences jumped ~1.6x on our CI instance.

raj: ugh, which test? seq len and batch size?

olivia: micro-bench: single-stream inference (batch=1), seq=32, model=rw-awq-4bit-int8 (weight-only AWQ group=32). p50 used to be 11.2ms, now 17.9ms. p95 46ms -> 72ms.

matt: did kernel-chooser start preferring the packed INT8 slowpath? recent change forces pack for group sizes <=64 for cache locality.

olivia: exactly — it started picking the packed kernel even when KV cache hit rate is high and micro-batching yields tiny payloads. packing overhead kills small seqs.

natalie: can you paste perf snippet from bench harness?

olivia: ```
# perf summary (local CI)
model: rw-awq-g32
seq:32 batch:1
old: p50=11.2ms p95=46.0ms
new: p50=17.9ms p95=72.4ms
kernel: packed-int8-vec (chosen) vs unpacked-int8-fast
pack_overhead=+6.8ms
kv_hit_rate=~95%
``` 

raj: interesting. maybe calibration windowing changed? if calibration bins changed, kernel chooser might misestimate pack benefit.

matt: good call — the chooser uses a simple estimator: estimated_tokens_saved = (1 - cache_hit)*seq + (batch-1)*seq, then multiplies by pack_speedup. If pack_speedup was tuned on longer sequences (seq>=128), it will overestimate for small seq.

natalie: I also noticed AWQ quant calibration added an extra memcpy in the pack hotpath for zeroed tails when group_size % 16 != 0. That would add latency for group sizes like 32.

olivia: steps I ran:
- reran with pack disabled -> p50 back to 10.9ms
- bisected to kernel-chooser commit -> confirmed chooser change
- probe: forced chooser to check kv_hit_rate threshold and prefer unpacked when kv_hit_rate>90% and batch<=2 -> p50=12.0ms

bench-bot: deploy-check: note heavy regression flagged on rw-awq-g32 for seq<=64. Ticket created: PERF-1142

matt: proposed fixes:
1) tighten chooser heuristic: compute expected amortized pack cost including memcpy_tail + packing_latency_per_group, prefer unpacked for short sequences and high cache hit.
2) special-case AWQ group sizes with non-16-aligned tails to prefer unpacked unless seq>64.
3) add micro-batching route: if batch<=2 and seq<=64 run unpacked-fast kernel.

raj: also worth experimenting with calibration windowing: calibrate pack_speedup on a mixed workload that biases short sequences. current calibration used dataset of long sequences.

olivia: agreed. I'll run a quick calibration sweep (group=16,32,64,128) with seq distribution {8,32,64,128} and report.

natalie: if you need a quick patch, matt's heuristic change + a feature-flag should be low-risk.

olivia: will open PR with flag + new heuristic and attach calibration results. Thanks all :thumbsup:

matt: please add perf counters for pack memcpy bytes and tail-mem ops so we can monitor in console.

olivia: adding that to PERF-1142. I'll post updates when the PR lands.
